title: Comprehensive Audits of Healthcare Institutions Seeking External Accreditation for Continuous Improvement
what_it_is: Comprehensive Audits of Healthcare Institutions Seeking External Accreditation for Continuous Improvement

sections.label: MOH inspections and Healthcare Services Bill
sections.summary: MOH conducts regular inspections and is working to replace the Private Hospitals and Medical Clinics Act with a new Healthcare Services Bill.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH carries out regular inspections to verify that these requirements are complied with.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For example, following a review and public consultation, MOH is working towards replacing the current Private Hospitals and Medical Clinics Act with a new Healthcare Services Bill that will better meet the needs of a changing healthcare landscape.

sections.label: External accreditation and customised quality regimes
sections.summary: MOH is working with healthcare institutions and international organisations to develop customised quality regimes and standards, moving beyond traditional accreditation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Some healthcare institutions have voluntarily undertaken external accreditations, such as those provided by the Joint Commission International (JCI).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: These accreditations had been useful in helping our healthcare institutions make continual improvements in their service standards and quality, but we will need to mature beyond traditional accreditation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To meet our unique needs, MOH is working with healthcare institutions to develop our own models of care.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We are also partnering them as well as leading international organisations, such as JCI, to develop more customised quality regimes and standards that meet our needs without imposing excessive burden on our healthcare workforce.

sections.label: Moving away from relentless auditing
sections.summary: One purpose is to move away from a focus on relentless auditing, and the timeline will be addressed to Ms Irene Quay.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: One of the purposes of this is to move away from the focus on just relentless auditing which many healthcare workers have given feedback about.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As for the timeline, we will have to come back to Ms Irene Quay.
